### 📓 Docs Drift Check
Nothing in this diff resolved to a documentable surface (no symbol, route or SDK anchor derived from **1** changed package(s)), so **this run has no opinion** about the docs.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **3** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json a46efa8c625f2b43d4aa1aa1044eb702667ba07d` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

### ① Derived judgments

- **Accuracy.** All 22 locale-leaves (ja-JP 8, es-ES 8, zh-CN 6) say what the current English says, with one ambiguity (S1). Vocabulary matches #37377: データソース / 指標 / グループ, fuente de datos / métrica / agrupación, 数据来源 / 指标 / 分组. The `matrix` / `joined` tokens are kept, as each bundle's own `type` hint keeps them.
- **The 2 skipped zh-CN leaves are current.** `chart.helpText` 图表类型与配置 is exactly "Chart type and settings." `filter_and_chart.description` 条件与图表展示 carries the meaning (N1). Both equal the console overlay.
- **Generated files.** The `*.generated.ts` name is about structure only. AGENTS.md's file table says translated-locale values (zh-CN / ja-JP / es-ES) are hand-written and that `check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write` merge mode keeps them; only `en` is rewritten from source. So the edit is in the right place and no source edit is owed. No key was added or dropped, and `en` is untouched. Neither source-hash table has a `metadataForms` entry, so no digest is owed.
- **Ledger.** The added sentence in `report-dataset-panel-echo-decisions.test.ts` is true on this head. No verdict or pinned value moved.
- **Card acceptance.** Every re-translated leaf is named in the PR table, and the 2 skipped ones are named. `Lint & Repo Gates` and `Test Core` are green on the head.

Findings:

S1 (should-fix) — es-ES `report.fields.order.helpText` opens "Por qué ordenar", which a Spanish reader takes first as "Why sort", not "What to sort by". The parenthesis rescues the meaning, so it does not block. Suggested: "Criterio de ordenación, lo más importante primero (una agrupación o una métrica)."
S2 (should-fix) — the stale reason in `dataset-panel-echo-decisions.test.ts` (the `include` label row cites `report.sections.joined_blocks.label is 关联对象`, which no bundle reads) needs a small card. It is the same class of false ledger citation this PR fixed in the report ledger, no gate catches it, and a note in a merged PR body is not a carrier. This is not a change to this PR.
N1 (nit) — zh-CN `filter_and_chart.description` 条件与图表展示 drops "Filter" and "how". 筛选条件与图表的展示方式 would be closer. It reads correctly under the 筛选与图表 heading.
N2 (nit) — ja-JP `dateRange.helpText` says 利用者 where the sibling hints (`dataset`, `exportOptions`) say ユーザー.

### ② Semver level

`patch` on `@objectstack/platform-objects` is right: translated strings only, no key, accepted value, default or English string changed. It matches #37377's changeset. `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` hold.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: none.
- Not filed, zh-CN `joined_blocks.label` (joined 报表分块 against the overlay's 联合报表的分块): no card needed. The label is outside the card, the bundle is self-consistent in keeping the `joined` token, and the overlay supplies the console's wording.
- Not filed, stale 关联对象 citation: needs a card (S2).
- Dev deviation, 3 gate families not measured locally: answered by CI, where the slot-lookup and corpus and the query-options erasure lint jobs are green on this head.
- SQL push-down: not applicable, the diff holds no query or join.
